claim_boundary: This preregisters one source-bound water V0-AQ-E fixed-geometry auxiliary QM--PCM stationarity control. It does not evaluate MACE gas energy, alter the MACE checkpoint, identify an auxiliary density with MACE density, use experimental solvation labels, provide a total solvation free energy, certify forces/PES, or report accuracy.

fixed_energy_ledger.auxiliary_difference: A_aux^(PCM-SCF)-A_aux^(gas-SCF), using fully converged total stationary energies of the same auxiliary QM method and geometry.
forbidden: An isolated implementation-specific PCM energy component in place of the stationary total-energy difference.
An extra PCM half-coupling, SMD CDS, fitted non-electrostatic term, or standard-state correction in this V0-AQ-E control.
MACE field response, auxiliary-density feature feedback, density projection, post-training, fine-tuning, MAP/UQ, response clipping, or target-label use.

force_boundary: Both auxiliary stationary-state analytic nuclear gradients are recorded only as same-scalar derivative evidence. No force, PES, optimization, scan, MD, or NVE claim is authorized before smooth-cavity/operator and independent central-difference, rigid-motion, and closed-loop-work gates pass.
decision_rule: A failed runtime, source, input, convergence, or numerical gate rejects this exact control. It does not authorize a retry with changed method/basis/grid/radius, a post-result parameter adjustment, or use of a benchmark score. A passed control only establishes its stated fixed-geometry auxiliary-QM stationarity evidence.
